verdict.rationale: A data-use and AI-training privacy question is fair to ask of any app that handles user files, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no privacy policy, data-collection statement, or AI-training opt-out for a-Shell. Being open source under the FreeBSD license is an adjacent fact and does not document how user data is handled.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
